guideline: Participants were asked to rate query-summary pairs on Succinctness and Coherence using a five-point Likert scale
For Relevance assessment, participants decided whether each sentence was relevant (score 5), partially relevant (score 2.5), or irrelevant (score 0)
Rate each summary on Succinctness, Coherence, and Relevance using a five-point Likert scale; also score sentence relevance (5, 2.5, 0).

overall_notes: Extraction quality was generally good. The paper focuses on query-focused abstractive summarization using a weakly supervised approach. Main contributions include the MARGE framework for evidence ranking and MARGESUM for abstractive generation. Evaluation uses both automatic metrics (ROUGE) and human assessment (Succinctness, Coherence, Relevance).
